<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Print every home-screen command and its keys (rebind them under [keymap] in config.toml)

```text
simstim config keymap [flags]
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for keymap
      --json   print JSON
```
